amendment_reason: T1.9 returned a divergent M3 result: single-epsilon Beta0 ratios > 1 (newcomers > spanning) at all four epsilon-star, but the integrated AUC ratio < 1 (spanning > newcomers, ~0.938, stable across epsilon-star). The single-epsilon ratios rest on tiny residual component counts (Beta0 2-48 of 8,000) at near-fully-merged scales (low information), while the AUC is bulk-dominated; and NO statistic carried a significance test (single matched draw). This amendment adds inferential grounding (permutation null + bootstrap CI) and a discriminating statistic so P01-A section 6 / P01-B section 3.4.2 can be locked on an inferential, not point-estimate, basis.

entries.name: Spanning vs newcomer H0 inferential re-analysis
entries.objective: Attach inferential grounding to the spanning-vs-newcomer H0 comparison and resolve the M3 divergence: is there a robust, significant structural difference, and in which direction?

permutation_null.description: Label-shuffle null: pool the matched spanning + newcomer samples, randomly relabel into two groups of the original sizes, recompute each statistic; two-sided empirical p-value = (r+1)/(B+1).

bootstrap_ci.description: Within-group resample with replacement, recompute each statistic, report 95% percentile CI.

discriminating_statistic.description: Replace the trivial-region-dominated AUC over [0, eps_star] with a non-trivial windowed / normalized statistic so the comparison is not swamped by the shared near-zero filtration where every point is isolated.
discriminating_statistic.definition: AUC of the normalized Beta0 curve (Beta0(eps)/n) integrated over a non-trivial window [eps_lo, eps_star], with eps_lo set to the first scale at which the mean across both groups drops below n/2 (i.e. exclude the all-isolated region). Report eps_lo used.
discriminating_statistic.rationale: Isolates the scales that actually discriminate the two groups.

decision_rule.newcomers_robust: The discriminating statistic shows newcomers > spanning with permutation p < 0.05 AND the direction is consistent across all four epsilon-star -> P01-A section 6 / P01-B section 3.4.2 may claim newcomers show more H0 structure (robust).
decision_rule.spanning_robust: The discriminating statistic shows spanning > newcomers with permutation p < 0.05 AND consistent across epsilon-star -> the headline is reversed; prose states spanning carry more / equal H0 structure.
decision_rule.no_robust_difference: The discriminating statistic is not significant (permutation p >= 0.05 or bootstrap CI straddles parity) at the locked epsilon-star -> no robust newcomer-vs-spanning H0 difference; the original headline is withdrawn / heavily qualified.
decision_rule.dual_metric_note: W2(D0_newcomer, D0_spanning) is reported with its own permutation null; a directional H0 claim must be consistent with the W2 evidence and must not rest on the noisy single-epsilon tail counts alone. Per CONVENTIONS, no conclusion on W2 (or any single statistic) alone.
